findings.title: Vite optimizer can rewrite runtime-root node_modules/.vite before the after-check
findings.reachableImpact: Vite getConfigHash includes plugins: config.plugins.map((p) => p.name). The driver adds plugin 'lanes78-address91'. The frozen _metadata.json has configHash 5e0aa88f. Nothing in the package proves that hash was made with the same plugin list. On mismatch Vite re-optimizes at server start and replaces node_modules/.vite in the runtime root. Runtime dependency discovery can do the same. The driver detects this only after the unit (line 711). The unit then fails, but the write outside the owned output has already happened and the frozen optimizer pin is destroyed for later units.
findings.smallestCompliantFix: Before createServer, prove reuse without writes: resolve the config with the exact plugin array, compute configHash and lockfileHash with the algorithm from the pinned Vite dist, compare with the pinned _metadata.json, and abort before createServer on mismatch. Block on any Vite optimizer log line during the unit. If the hash cannot be proven, Root keeps the bounded-write claim BLOCKED. No cache copy, no warmup, no rebuild exception.
